rules.title: OpenSSH 9.1 pre-authentication double free (candidate)
rules.severity_basis: Local triage label only; upstream release note supplies no CVSS score
conditions: Confirm actual OpenSSH server package, portable patch level and distribution backports.
Upstream introduced the issue in 9.1 and fixed it in 9.2; 8.9 does not match.
The release note describes pre-authentication sandbox mitigation; this match does not establish exploitability.
